text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- Crisis in the ruling coalition continues. The ethnic Albanian PDP party is dissatisfied with the interior ministry report on events in Gostivar.

- British ambassador Mark Dickinson met PDP president Abdurahman Aliti on behalf of the EU, welcomed its policy of dialogue and tolerance and said the party should remain in the coalition, paper sources say.
- Milk price went up by 12 percent to 28 denars or 0.9 German marks.
- New opportunities for development of Russian-Macedonian relations open after the visit of Macedonian Defense Minister Lazar Kitanovski to Russia, paper commentary.

- Permanent U.S. representative to the United Nations Bill Richardson is on an official visit to Macedonia. Richardson is scheduled to meet president Kiro Gligorov, prime minister Branko Crvenkovski and foreign minister Blagoj Handziski.
- Association of depositors of the bankrupt TAT savings society from Bitola will organise a new protest rally on Thursday in Bitola.
